NIST Fully-Toleranced Test Case 08, ASME1, AP242 tessellated geometry

The retained file step-nist-ap242-tessellated.stp is an unchanged copy of
NIST-PMI-STEP-Files/nist_ftc_08_asme1_ap242-e4-tg.stp, renamed for the corpus.

The upstream archive explains that its STEP files are not error-free
reference files, and identifies this export as tessellated part geometry.
This fixture qualifies the selected part's geometry and thumbnail; it does
not establish full AP242 schema or PMI conformance.
